description: This file defines a PHP class 'Auth_Container_ADOdb' that implements a storage driver for user authentication data using ADOdb to connect to various databases. It includes methods for database connection, fetching user data, listing users, and managing user records.

classes.name: Auth_Container_ADOdb
classes.description: A PHP class that provides database-backed user authentication storage using ADOdb, supporting multiple database types and allowing user management operations.

methods.name: Auth_Container_ADOdb
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with a DSN string or array of options, setting default values and parsing options.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Private method to establish a database connection using the provided DSN.

methods.name: _prepare
methods.description: Ensures an active database connection before executing database operations.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query on the connected database.

methods.name: _setDefaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration options for database connection and table parameters.

methods.name: _parseOptions
methods.description: Parses and merges user-provided options into the class configuration.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Retrieves user login data from the database by username, verifies password, and stores additional user info.

methods.name: listUsers
methods.description: Returns an array of all users from the database.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Adds a new user with a password and optional additional data to the database.

methods.name: removeUser
methods.description: Deletes a user by username from the database.
